attacks.claim: The day cards hard-code a white background while the text color follows the dark-mode variable. In dark mode (about 30% of users, supported since v5) the card is white and the text is near-white (#f2f2f7), so planner content is effectively unreadable. The QA report covers only light mode, so this regression is untested.
attacks.evidence: .day-card { background: #ffffff; color: var(--text); ... } alongside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { --text: #f2f2f7; ... } } and "Visual QA vs Figma: Chrome 1440px (light), Safari iPhone 14 (light) — pass"
